slice: RPP-5la selected AC1027 three-element MLINE retarget tail append
scope: Extends the selected MLINE tail-append retarget regression from a two-element source style to one source-count-three case: retarget two source-bound MLINE consumers to a target style whose fourth element is appended. Verifies the exact style and consumer fields, output ownership, readback, source-edit refusal, late-mutation rollback, and same-adapter retries. It qualifies only this AC1027 source-count-three profile.

references.use: Groups 71 and 49 encode the element count and element offsets, with repeated 49/62/6 element tuples; group 70 contains flags. These field definitions do not prescribe consumer geometry regeneration.

Group 340 identifies the MLINESTYLE object; group 2 is its redundant name; group 73 is its element count; groups 74/41 carry segment-parameter counts and values; groups 75/42 carry fill-parameter counts and values; and groups 13/23/33 carry vertex miter vectors.

contract.admission: Runtime-authored AC1027 source. The original style and target style each have flags 2, angles 90/90, and three geometry offsets [1.25,-0.75,-1.25]. The two consumers have three vertices, three source lines, are open, uncut and unfilled, and are owned by model space and one named block. The target receives a fourth tail element at offset -2.25, ACI 4, ByLayer. Both consumers are retargeted by group-340 identity while group-2 names remain unchanged.
contract.projection: Require an exact source-bound 3-to-4 target-style append: flags and angles unchanged, all three original offsets preserved as an ordered prefix, and a nonempty target tail. Recompute each consumer's first group-41 parameter using the target's full minimum offset (-2.25); preserve its source vertex positions, segment directions, miter geometry and zero second parameter. Bottom justification uses the resulting +2.25 shift. This is not a general MLINE regeneration algorithm.
contract.outputAndReadback: Across ASCII/binary source and output, verify both source style records and owner dictionary keys, group 70/71/49/62/6 tuples, both MLINE references and unchanged redundant group 2, group 73=4, exact per-element groups 74/75/41, miter groups 13/23/33, model/block ownership, and fresh readback of both styles and consumers with the expected four-element target and projected parameters.
contract.failureAndRetry: For ASCII and binary output, perturbing an existing target offset refuses atomically, preserves a destination sentinel and caller snapshot, and succeeds after restoring the source on the same adapter. A late consumer parameter mutation also refuses atomically; restoring caller state allows retry. Both retries receive complete output and fresh-readback proofs.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. Source and output DXFs are generated at runtime in a temporary directory and removed after a passing run. No drawing fixtures are committed.
contract.limits: Evidence covers only AC1027 source style count 3 to target count 4 by one tail append, flags 2, equal 90/90 angles, the specified offsets/ACI/LTYPE tuples, two open/uncut/unfilled three-vertex consumers, and ASCII/binary encoding combinations. Other source counts, append batches, target arities, style flags, angles, offset patterns, schemas, carriers, versions, native CAD semantics, complete-document closure and broader support claims remain unqualified.

controls.observed: Across this and the paired 2-to-3 profile, successful append-retarget profiles=8; output/readback proofs including retries=16; source-mutation refusals with rollback=4; late-mutation refusals with rollback=4; same-adapter retries=8. Each count includes both source arities.
controls.runtimeFixturePolicy: All source and output DXFs are generated at runtime by the focused test. No DWG/DXF fixture is added to the repository.

focusedSuite.summary: All four focused MLINE retarget/append selectors passed (4/4); the retarget-append selector covers both 2-to-3 and 3-to-4 profiles.

next: Select another source-backed retarget-append profile—prefer source count four to five if an exact expected result is available—or take a different witnessed P2 geometry operation. If no useful distinguishing input is ready, use the bounded dense retained-byte boundary. Keep the selected source, emitted fields, readback, failure/retry evidence and claim boundary explicit.
